services.name: Land rental
services.desc: With decades of experience exploring Utah’s wild terrain, we’ve redefined what a guided UTV experience can be. Thanks to our permits with the Heber-Kamas Ranger District, we have access to over 150,000 acres of stunning national forest trails, alpine meadows, and high-country viewpoints-far beyond what most outfitters can offer. Whether you're brand new to UTVs or a seasoned off-roader, our expert guides will take you beyond the map and into the heart of adventure. Get ready for an unforgettable ride through some of the most breathtaking terrain around! blurb: Lofty Peaks Adventures LLC offers year-round rentals and guided tours of side-by-side UTVs and snowmobiles in the Heber Valley area near Park City, Utah. Guests can explore off-road trails, sand, mud, and mountain terrain in summer, and carve fresh powder in winter. Guided snowmobile trips provide expert navigation of 150,000+ acres of backcountry with tailored experiences for all skill levels.
